digest.component_or_area: LLM model class configuration and resolution
propositions: Rebar lacks a schema to express which model corresponds to which capability tier (trivial, standard, frontier), forcing per-pass decisions to be inferred

Configuration needs three named slots (trivial, standard, frontier) accepting model, provider, endpoint, and optional fallback arrays, parsed from existing layered config (CLI > env > file > default) with secrets excluded
A resolver function must map class names to provider-qualified model strings, inferring the provider via infer_provider when omitted, and returning documented defaults when slots are unset
Fallback entries must be validated as non-recursive sub-objects carrying model/provider/endpoint without api_key, with cycle risk and unbounded depth prevented by rejecting nested fallback keys

Environment variables must address nested slot fields individually (REBAR_LLM_FRONTIER_MODEL, REBAR_LLM_FRONTIER_PROVIDER, etc.) to preserve existing precedence rules per key rather than inventing object merges
The load_class_slots entry point must read the model_classes sub-table from the merged [tool.rebar.llm] config and return resolved slots, proving the parser is reachable from real configuration
